hero-azahar.papel: Héroe principal con espacio negativo para el titular a 375 y 1366 px.
hero-azahar.prompt: Fotografía editorial documental panorámica de un camping familiar mediano en una llanura litoral valenciana, al amanecer de primavera. Una calle de grava clara pasa bajo naranjos adultos en flor, con copas verdes reales y azahar blanco discreto; dos parcelas ordenadas y una caravana totalmente genérica muestran escala. Al fondo aparece una recepción baja encalada con cubierta cerámica. Luz suave, atmósfera fresca y amplio espacio negativo a la izquierda para titular. Ninguna persona, rostro, texto, señal legible, matrícula, logotipo, fruta gigantesca, palmera tropical, mar visible, resort, HDR ni saturación naranja.

vida-llegada.papel: Escena humana de llegada familiar bajo los cítricos.
vida-llegada.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: human editorial scene for the Camping Els Tarongers demo website
Primary request: Photoreal editorial documentary photograph of a family of three finishing a calm arrival at a Taronger pitch in the same modest Valencian citrus campsite.
Input images: tipo-parcela-taronger.webp is the exact mature orange-tree shade, pale draining gravel, low pitch boundary, compact generic caravan, plain outdoor table and white chairs reference.
Scene/backdrop: One clearly bounded pitch beneath living orange trees; the caravan, table and access lane remain recognisable and practical.
Subject: Two adults aged roughly 35–50 and one child aged roughly 7–10 complete two small tasks: one adult places exactly one small plain folding chair beside the existing table while the child sets one reusable water bottle on the tabletop; the second adult carries one compact soft bag from the blank side of the caravan.
Style/medium: Natural editorial documentary photography, 35 mm lens, restrained citrus green, warm white and pale gravel palette, subtle film grain.
Composition/framing: Horizontal 3:2, pitch geometry and tree shade dominate; the family occupies 15–28 percent and remains in the central 70 percent for mobile crop.
Lighting/mood: Soft late-morning shade, practical and unhurried rather than posed.
Constraints: All three people and every object remain fully inside the pitch with a clear empty gravel strip before the lane; plausible hands and chair joints; anonymous side/back views; caravan side completely blank with no badge, characters, number or licence plate; no object touches or is tied to a tree.
Avoid: picking fruit, child climbing, gear across lane, cable on ground, hammock, rug, campfire, readable text, logos, frontal smiles, duplicate chairs, extra fingers, HDR, luxury advertising, watermark.

vida-servicio-piscina.papel: Uso intergeneracional sereno de la piscina familiar.

Asset type: human editorial scene for the Camping Els Tarongers demo website
Primary request: Photoreal editorial documentary photograph of one older adult and one school-age child quietly cooling their feet at the modest family pool in the same Valencian citrus campsite.

Subject: One older adult aged roughly 60–75 and one child aged roughly 8–11 sit side by side on the coping, seen from behind, with both pairs of lower legs in the main pool; exactly two plain folded towels rest together on the dry paving beside the adult.

vida-entorno.papel: Salida intergeneracional en bicicleta entre huerta y costa.
vida-entorno.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: human editorial scene for the Camping Els Tarongers demo website
Primary request: Photoreal editorial documentary photograph of an intergenerational family of three taking an easy bicycle outing on the public greenway near the same Valencian citrus campsite.
Input images: entorno.webp is the exact flat public route between mature citrus orchards, low protected irrigation channel, irregular field boundaries, hazy coastal light and everyday agricultural scale reference.
Scene/backdrop: One continuous firm public route crosses the citrus landscape; the protected channel remains outside the riding surface and no one enters the orchard.
Subject: One adult aged roughly 60–75, one adult aged roughly 35–50 and one child aged roughly 9–12 ride away in loose single file on three ordinary upright city or touring bicycles, wearing correctly fitted plain helmets and casual clothes.
Style/medium: Natural editorial documentary photography, 35 mm lens, restrained leaf green, pale earth and coastal haze palette, subtle film grain.
Composition/framing: Horizontal 3:2, route and orchard dominate; riders occupy 12–24 percent and remain in the central 60 percent for mobile crop, with all three bicycle wheels fully visible.
Lighting/mood: Fresh early morning, easy shared movement rather than sports advertising.
Constraints: Plausible bicycle frames, circular wheels, pedals, hands and riding posture; anonymous back views; safe spacing; all six wheels remain on the established route; channel protection stays continuous.
Avoid: fruit picking, orchard shortcut, racing kits, electric-bike branding, cargo trailer, car, traffic danger, readable sign, logos, frontal pose, malformed bicycles, duplicate wheels, extra limbs, beach resort, HDR, saturation, watermark.
